items.headline: Case Keenum drives Chicago to 3 touchdowns as the Bears beat the Eagles 27-7
items.description: — Case Keenum passed for two touchdowns in his first start in almost three years, and the Chicago Bears shut down Jalen Hurts and the Philadelphia Eagles for a 27-7 victory on Monday night.

items.headline: QB3 Case Keenum, Bears defense shock Eagles in MNF rout
items.description: Keenum stepped up big in a pressure situation and combined with a defensive gem to lead the Bears past the Eagles.

items.headline: Jonathan Greenard (pectoral) makes Eagles debut on Monday
items.description: Edge Jonathan Greenard made his Eagles debut Monday night. He had been sidelined because of a pectoral injury.

items.headline: NFL asks DHS to take down Brian Dawkins social media video
items.description: The NFL asked DHS to remove a social media post likening former Eagles star Brian Dawkins' greatest hits to immigration agents' treatment of migrants.
